text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Intraventricular Hemorrhage (IVH) secondary to germinal matrix hemorrhage in a preterm infant.

The cranial ultrasound confirming ventricular bleeding, combined with the tense anterior fontanelle, lethargy, seizures, and bradycardia (60/30 BP), indicates an acute hemorrhagic event. While the history of chorioamnionitis raises concern for sepsis, the specific imaging findings and focal neurological signs point primarily to IVH as the cause of this decompensation. We should immediately manage airway protection and intracranial pressure while ruling out concurrent sepsis.
